author: Real-Fruit-Snacks
install: Run `t3 theme set apps/t3code/cyclorama-dawn.json` or Settings -> Themes -> Import theme
installSteps: **CLI one-liner:** Run `t3 theme set apps/t3code/cyclorama-dawn.json` (inspect with `t3 theme show`, reset with `t3 theme clear`).
**Desktop UI:** Open T3 Code -> **Settings** -> **Themes** -> **Import theme** and paste the complete JSON snippet below.
**Manual folder:** Copy `cyclorama-*.json` into `~/.t3/userdata/themes/` and choose **Cyclorama Dawn**, **Cyclorama Steel**, or **Cyclorama Day**.

themes.name: Cyclorama Dawn
